example_limits: Original bounded order-line splitter with strict decoded-input fields, ASCII identifiers, 0..100 lines and 1..1000 integer physical units per line. Two frozen child values retain immutable event/order/line identity, SKU, units, one-based position and size. Structured (parent event ID, line ID) keys distinguish repeated SKUs and survive replay and reordering; event IDs must be unique within the integration and immutable. Full validation precedes tuple construction. Empty input returns no children, invalid late elements return no partial tuple, and input is not mutated. No broker, publication, acknowledgments, deduplication store, aggregation, concurrent mutation, durable handoff, authentication, or external effects are implemented. Order-line motivation follows EIP; code, figures, bounds, fixtures, and policies are original.
publication: Local implementation only. No publishing, deployment, commit, push, or pull request.
